title: Voltas Beko 466L French Door Refrigerator
description: This French door refrigerator has a net capacity of 466L and a gross capacity of 522L. It includes 5-in-1 modes, surround air cooling and a ProSmart inverter compressor.

highlights.title: Surround Air Cooling System
highlights.subtitle: Circulates cold air evenly from corner to corner

highlights.title: Harvest Fresh
highlights.subtitle: Keeps fruits and veggies fresh and nutritious longer

highlights.title: ProSmart Inverter Compressor
highlights.subtitle: Energy efficient, quiet, and built to last
